_comment: Pointer to the render baselines hosted as GitHub release assets, for the
suites that do not gate CI and are per machine (tests/full_renders and
tests/path_traced). tests/fast is deliberately absent: it stays in git so
an ordinary clone and an ordinary CI run never fetch anything.
'tag' is null until the assets are uploaded. While it is null -- and
while the mp4s are still committed -- nothing here is consulted: the
in-repo expected_outputs_<key>/ answers first. See tests/baseline_store.py
for the resolution order and scripts/package_baselines.py for how the
sha256s below are produced (reproducibly, so any machine can check them).
